CustomField.formula:
IF(
AND(
(Appointment_Date__c - TODAY()) + MOD( TODAY() - DATE(1900, 1, 8), 7) <= -1,
Appointment_Date__c - TODAY() >= (-7 - MOD( TODAY() - DATE(1900, 1, 8), 7))
)
,"Last Week",
IF(
AND(
(Appointment_Date__c - TODAY()) + MOD( TODAY() - DATE(1900, 1, 8), 7) >= 0,
(Appointment_Date__c - TODAY()) + MOD( TODAY() - DATE(1900, 1, 8), 7) <= 6
)
,"This Week",
IF(
AND(
(Appointment_Date__c - TODAY()) + MOD( TODAY() - DATE(1900, 1, 8), 7) >= 7,
(Appointment_Date__c - TODAY()) + MOD( TODAY() - DATE(1900, 1, 8), 7) <= 13
)
,"Next Week",null
)))
CustomField.label: Appointment Week
